This page documents a [[id:31C868B9-306E-4282-BA8C-07E647021B34][task]] in the [[id:BAAFD7B2-A37F-4ED8-A9F2-E2A997E3D488][Integrate the Volga TypeScript UI as ores.web]] story. It captures the goal, current status, acceptance, and any notes or results.

* Goal

One codegen run writes every generated TypeScript file into projects/ores.web, the hand-copied copies and projects/ores.typescript are gone, and a drift check fails when the model and the checked-in output disagree.

- ores.codegen writes the ui and protocol TypeScript into projects/ores.web.
- projects/ores.typescript is deleted.
- The hand-copy script sync-generated.sh is deleted.

* Result

Retargeted. =ores.ts.ui.ui_meta= writes to
=projects/ores.web/packages/web/src/generated/{component}/ui/{entity}_ui.ts=,
and =ores.ts.protocol.protocol_types= writes to
=projects/ores.web/packages/wire-protocol/src/generated/{component}/protocol/{entity}_protocol.ts=.
The hand-written =ui-contract.ts= moved out of the generated tree to
=packages/web/src/=. =projects/ores.typescript= and =scripts/sync-generated.sh=
are gone.

Regenerating reproduces the 90 UI modules byte for byte apart from the
contract import, reproduces the 6 protocol modules exactly, and adds the 17
=dq=, =scheduler= and =trading= modules the checked-in tree was missing.

=check_component_drift.py --all= reports no drift in the generated tree. Its
only complaint is the pre-existing uncommitted edit to
=projects/ores.compass/tests/test_deny_bare_stash_hook.py=, which is not part
of this branch. The drift gate's registry does not list every component that
emits UI metadata, so the coverage gap below stays open.
